title: Resilient Caller: Backoff, Deadline, Circuit Breaker, Idempotency Key
instructions: Implement `CircuitBreaker`, `full_jitter` and `ResilientCaller` in `resilient_call.py` (`errors.py` is provided). `call(fn)` passes the same idempotency key to every attempt, retries retryable errors with full-jitter backoff (at least `retry_after` for `RateLimited`), raises `DeadlineExceeded` without sleeping when the delay will not fit, and fails fast while the breaker is open. Time, sleep and randomness are all injected.

evidence.label: Retries transient errors and reuses the same idempotency key on every attempt
Non-retryable errors propagate after one attempt with no sleep
Retry-After is a lower bound for the delay
Re-raises the last error after max_attempts without a final sleep
Raises DeadlineExceeded (chained) instead of sleeping past the deadline
Breaker opens, fails fast without calling the dependency, then recovers
Half-open failure re-opens at once and a success resets the failure count
Each retry logs a WARNING with attempt and delay in extra
The default key factory gives a new key per call but a stable key across retries
